annotations.title: FXRate: Daily exchange-rate history for a currency pair

description:
Daily ECB reference rates for one currency pair between start and end (max 366 days), with first, last, min, max and percent change. Free: 30 calls/day per IP, then $0.002 per call.

[FXRate via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as FXRate's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: history $0.002 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

base.description: Base currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (31 supported)

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date (default: today); max 366 days after start

quote.description: Quote currency: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (31 supported)

tier.description: Paid tier: history $0.002. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
